text:
Predicates:
Affection(x) ::: x is affection.
Love(x) ::: x is love.
Positive(x) ::: x is positive.

Premises:
∃x (Affection(x) ∧ Love(x)) ::: Some affection is love.
∃x (Love(x) ∧ Positive(x)) ::: Some love is positive.

Conclusion:
∃x (Affection(x) ∧ Positive(x)) ::: Some affection is positive.
